tips.text: Run Duviri solo on normal, not Steel Path; the extra Banes cost far more time than they save.
Kill Kullervo and the Orowyrm in the same spiral; leaving after only one pays zero Banes.
Check the mood before launching; Kullervo's Hold only spawns in Anger, Sorrow and Fear, never Envy or Joy.
Take 6 to 10 decrees, go straight to the Hold, and aim for about 15 minutes a run.
Pick Alchemy as the Undercroft node when solo; it is the fastest at 2 to 3 minutes.
Use The Duviri Experience, not The Lone Story; Kullervo only appears there if he is a main objective.
Gather Pathos Clamps and Duviri resources in the same runs as the Banes.
Shoot the Orowyrm's orbs with the Orvius for currents that speed your Kaithe, or grapple from max range and re-grapple to close in.
Stand outside the fire ring on Steel Path and shoot the wyrmlings, so the Kaithe phase can be skipped.
Expect two to three evenings of casual play; the mood clock, not the Rauta, is the grind.
